sources.summary: Calling all community designers to join us for ACD49 in Bozeman, Montana! ACD49: Enduring Optimism marks the return of the Association for Community Design’s annual conference with a two-day convening on October 2-3, 2026. ACD49 is hosted by the Montana Community Design Center at Montana State University. As the center marks its 50th year, this gathering reflects on the endurance of community design as both a movement and a practice.
